content: We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. Then analyze isotopic patterns: look for characteristic isotopic spacing and relative intensities. For example: Chlorine (Cl) shows M+2 ~ 1/3 intensity of M (Cl-35 75.8%, Cl-37 24.2%). Bromine shows M+2 ~ equal intensity. Sulfur shows M+2 ~ 4% (S-34). Carbon shows M+1 ~ 1.1% per carbon. But we need to identify definitively based on visible patterns. We need the spectrum to see peaks. Let's retrieve spectrum.
